title: Memory Atom — Tech Stack (v1)
description: Schema for specs/memory/tech-stack.yaml. Governs the tech-stack memory atom. additionalProperties:false enforces D-5 atomicity.

languages.description: Programming languages used. Each entry maps to one table row (3 cols). Template variable: languages_rows.

usage.description: Description of how and where this language is used.

runtimes.description: Runtimes and tools. Each entry maps to one table row (3 cols). Template variable: runtimes_rows.

role.description: Role/function of this tool in the stack.

dependencies.description: Approved PyPI/external dependencies. Each entry maps to one table row (4 cols). Template variable: dependencies_rows.

layer.description: Architectural layer this dependency belongs to (e.g. 'features', 'infrastructure', 'dev').

justification.description: Why this dependency is approved and what it does.

constraints.description: Technology restrictions and prohibitions. Each entry maps to one <li> bullet. Template variable: constraints_bullets.

canonical_commands.description: Canonical commands for running, testing, linting and packaging. Rendered as a <pre><code> block. Template variable: canonical_commands.
